import pytest

def test_sv4ss01_compositional():

    assert e.tag == 'span' and e.get('class') == 'badge badge-pass'
    assert e.text == 'Passed' and e.get('role') == 'status'

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import progress


def test_sv4ss02_compositional():
    e = ET.fromstring(progress.render(1, 3))
    assert e.get('role') == 'progressbar' and e.get('aria-valuenow') == '1' and e.get('aria-valuemax') == '3'
    assert e.find('span').text == '33%' and e.find('div').get('style') == 'width: 33%'

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import progress


def test_sv4ss02_boundary():
    over = ET.fromstring(progress.render(5, 4))
    assert over.find('span').text == '100%' and over.get('aria-valuenow') == '4'
    assert ET.fromstring(progress.render(-2, 4)).find('span').text == '0%'
